shared_elements: upright slab/stele with carved decoration on the broad face
abstract curvilinear symbols/motifs incised on the stone body
paired/mirrored motif elements arranged symmetrically about a vertical axis
justification: Both are upright shaped slabs carved on their broad face with a vertical stack of abstract curvilinear symbols, including a prominent disc-like circular motif and paired motifs set symmetrically about a central axis, which is a fairly specific shared scheme. However, A additionally depicts explicit figural scenes (a mounted/seated figure, a boat-like structure, animals) and is framed throughout by a continuous interlace border, whereas B shows only isolated abstract symbols with no interlace frame and no recognisable figures or narrative content.
